Ask one rating question

Usage: jev score [OPTIONS] <INSTRUCTIONS> [LEVEL]...

Arguments:
  <INSTRUCTIONS>
          What the model should rate

  [LEVEL]...
          Level description, low end of the scale first (2 to 10 levels). `--` must come after every
          flag

Options:
      --id <ID>
          Question id
          
          [default: q]

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')

  -V, --version
          Print version

State:
  -s, --state <TEXT>
          State text

  -f, --state-file <PATH>
          Read the state from a file (`-` means stdin)

      --state-json
          Parse the state as a JSON object, array or string

Output:
  -o, --output <FORMAT>
          Output format

          Possible values:
          - text: Two-decimal blocks for `ask`, one bare value for a single question, the action
            name for `decide`, and the action's own output for `call`
          - json: The response document plus `cost_usd`. `decide` and `call` put the decision first
          
          [default: text]

      --json
          Shorthand for `--output json`

  -v, --verbose
          After a successful request, print model, tokens, retries and estimated cost on stderr

      --debug
          Print each failed attempt on stderr as it happens

      --dry-run
          Print the request JSON and do not send it. No API key is required

Connection:
      --api-key <KEY>
          API key (`TYPESAFE_API_KEY`). Prefer the environment variable: flags are visible to other
          processes

      --base-url <URL>
          API endpoint (`JEV_BASE_URL`)
          
          [default: https://api.typesafe.ai/v1/systemone]

      --model <NAME>
          Model name (`JEV_MODEL`)
          
          [default: jev-latest]

      --timeout <SECONDS>
          Per-request timeout in whole seconds (`JEV_TIMEOUT`), 1 to 86400. Also bounds connecting
          
          [default: 60]

      --retries <N>
          Extra attempts after the first for transient failures (`JEV_RETRIES`)
          
          [default: 8]
